split_policy: Independent task-specific models using each release's official train/dev/test partitions; no parameter sharing across tasks or releases.
representation: Same frozen C/A/Q/V event views and training-fitted 24-dimensional view projections as formal PsyPath-GFN. Only event_projections are imported from development checkpoints; policy, PIM, predictions and thresholds are not reused.
pooling: Mean and population standard deviation over all event rows of the formal 172-dimensional event vector; 344 pooled features, scaled using Train only.
architecture: Linear(344,H), GELU, Dropout(0.1), Linear(H,H/2), GELU, two independent linear scalar outputs for screening logit and normalized severity.
loss: Train-positive-weighted BCEWithLogits + 0.3 * mean absolute normalized severity error over observed-score cases; missing score is masked, never zero-imputed as a target.
selection: Per task and seed: largest Dev weighted F1, then AUROC, then smallest joint Dev loss; earlier candidate/checkpoint wins exact ties. All four candidate traces retained.
thresholds: Dev only: 0.10 through 0.90 inclusive, step 0.005; weighted F1, then macro F1, then proximity to 0.5.
test_gate: All 15 selected checkpoint hashes and thresholds committed before loading Test targets or generating Test predictions. Predictions from all 15 runs committed before Test targets loaded for scoring.
reporting: All five seeds; means and sample SD. Do not drop negative comparisons or retune after Test.
scope: Supervision-matched ordinary pooling baseline; not a compute-matched or parameter-matched ablation, and not full-backbone finetuning.
